We provide safe and secure units for both long- and short-term storage dependent on your needs. Our rates are competitive and tailored to your specific requirements and your choice of storage unit. paragraphs.text: Local museums
paragraphs.translation: 当地博物馆

paragraphs.text: A Whittlesey Museum
paragraphs.translation: A 惠特尔西博物馆

paragraphs.text: The museum is located in the Old Town Hall, which was originally built to house horse-drawn fire engines. It has eight rooms, and the exhibits cover topics such as archive photographs, costume, domestic life and local celebrities.
paragraphs.translation:
该博物馆位于旧市政厅内，该建筑最初是为了容纳马拉消防车而建造的。
博物馆有八个房间，展品涵盖档案照片、服饰、家庭生活以及当地名人等主题。

paragraphs.text: B Octavia Hill's Birthplace House
paragraphs.translation: B 奥克塔维亚·希尔的故居

paragraphs.text: Built in 1740, this is the birthplace of pioneer social reformer Octavia Hill, who was active in the late 19th and early 20th centuries in social housing and the arts, as well as in conservation issues. Visitors are taken on a guided tour and are then free to explore the gardens.
paragraphs.translation:
这座建于1740年的建筑是先驱社会改革家奥克塔维亚·希尔的出生地，她在19世纪末和20世纪初活跃于社会住房、艺术以及保护议题领域。
游客将由导游带领参观，之后可以自由探索花园。

paragraphs.text: C Chatteris Museum
paragraphs.translation: C 查特里斯博物馆

paragraphs.text: The old market town of Chatteris was largely rebuilt, after two serious fires in 1706 and 1864 destroyed many of the town's ancient buildings. The museum's exhibits illustrate traditional aspects of the life of local farmers as well as the railway boom of the 19th century. The museum has a touch-screen kiosk which contains over 9,000 historic photographs and texts, reproductions of which can be made on request.
paragraphs.translation:
古老的集镇查特里斯在1706年和1864年两场严重火灾摧毁了镇上的许多古老建筑后，进行了大规模重建。
博物馆的展品展示了当地农民生活的传统风貌，以及19世纪的铁路繁荣景象。
博物馆设有一个触摸屏信息亭，内藏超过9000张历史照片和文献，可根据要求提供复制品。

paragraphs.text: D March and District Museum
paragraphs.translation: D 马奇与地区博物馆

paragraphs.text: Located in the middle of the market town of March, the museum is housed in a former school built in 1851. Its wide-ranging collections include reconstructions of an early 20th-century kitchen, sitting room and nursery. There is also an interesting display of historic cameras and radios, and a medal which was awarded to train driver Ben Gimbert for his bravery in preventing loss of life when a train full of explosives caught fire in 1944.
paragraphs.translation:
该博物馆位于马奇集镇的中心，坐落在一所建于1851年的前校舍内。
其广泛的藏品包括20世纪早期厨房、起居室和育儿室的重建场景。
此外，还有一个有趣的历史相机和收音机展览，以及一枚颁给火车司机本·金伯特的奖章，表彰他在1944年一列满载炸药的火车起火时英勇防止人员伤亡的行为。

paragraphs.text: E Wisbech and Fenland Museum
paragraphs.translation: E 维斯贝奇与芬兰博物馆

paragraphs.text: This 19th-century gem holds collections from around the world including Ancient Egypt. Its library, which is open to the public on the first Saturday of each month, contains the manuscript of Great Expectations by the 19th-century novelist Charles Dickens, and the Research Room can be booked for researching local records.
paragraphs.translation:
这座19世纪的瑰宝收藏了来自世界各地的藏品，包括古埃及的物品。
其图书馆每月第一个周六向公众开放，收藏了19世纪小说家查尔斯·狄更斯的《远大前程》手稿，同时研究间可预约用于查阅当地记录。

parts.title: Passage 2
parts.article_title: Workplace health and safety considerations for plumbers

paragraphs.text: Like many trades, plumbing can be a dangerous job. It is important to take all reasonably practicable measures to keep customers and yourself incident and injury free.
paragraphs.translation:
与许多行业一样，水管工可能是一项危险的工作。
采取所有合理可行的措施以确保客户和自身免受事故和伤害至关重要。

paragraphs.text: Biohazard waste
paragraphs.translation: 生物危害废物

paragraphs.text: Plumbers regularly come into contact with biohazard waste. It's the nature of the job, but that doesn't mean you should be complacent about it. According to Safe Work Australia, communicable diseases from work-related exposures to biological hazards such as sewage have been estimated to cause 320,000 deaths across the globe each year. In addition to this, plumbers are regularly exposed to other biohazards such as mould, bacteria and algae. Don't risk it - make sure appropriate protective clothing and equipment is used.
paragraphs.translation:
生物危害废物
水管工经常接触生物危害废物。
这是工作的本质，但这并不意味着你应该对此掉以轻心。
根据澳大利亚安全工作署的数据，工作中接触污水等生物危害导致的传染病估计每年在全球造成32万人死亡。
除此之外，水管工还经常接触到其他生物危害，如霉菌、细菌和藻类。
不要冒险——确保使用适当的防护服和设备。

paragraphs.text: Confined spaces
paragraphs.translation: 密闭空间

paragraphs.text: Plumbers may spend much of their time working in confined spaces, where they are at risk from contaminants, including airborne gases, vapours and dusts, that may cause injury from fire or explosion. They may also be exposed to high concentrations of airborne contaminants that may be harmful to health. For example, one plumber was fined $220,000 after an employee suffered from carbon-monoxide poisoning. Another potential hazard for plumbers in confined spaces is that of drowning, if water sources are not adequately cut off.
paragraphs.translation:
密闭空间
水管工可能花费大量时间在狭小空间工作，在那里他们面临来自污染物的风险，包括空气中的气体、蒸汽和粉尘，这些污染物可能因火灾或爆炸而导致伤害。
他们还可能接触到高浓度的空气中的污染物，这些污染物可能对健康有害。
例如，一名水管工因一名员工遭受一氧化碳中毒而被罚款22万美元。
水管工在狭小空间中的另一个潜在危险是溺水，如果水源没有被充分切断的话。

paragraphs.text: The Safe Work Australia confined spaces code of practice outlines the necessary steps and precautions for avoiding illness and injury.
paragraphs.translation:
密闭空间
澳大利亚安全工作局的《密闭空间操作规程》列出了避免疾病和伤害的必要步骤与预防措施。

paragraphs.text: Electricity
paragraphs.translation: 电力

paragraphs.text: The Master Plumbers' Association calls electricity 'plumbing's hidden killer'. Metal pipes are often conductive and so gloves which provide insulation should form part of a plumber's tool kit, as should a plumbing voltage monitor and a volt tester. Gloves should be checked prior to every use and replaced every 12 to 14 months. Electrical equipment like bridging conductors should be regularly checked, with appropriate tags on the equipment to verify its safety. The project should be stopped immediately if there is any sign of electricity, so that the power can be disconnected by a qualified electrician prior to continuing work.
paragraphs.translation:
电力
水暖大师协会将电称为‘水暖行业的隐形杀手’。
金属管道通常具有导电性，因此提供绝缘功能的手套应成为水暖工工具箱的一部分，水暖电压监测器和电压测试仪也应如此。
手套应在每次使用前进行检查，并每12至14个月更换一次。
桥接导线等电气设备应定期检查，并在设备上附有适当的标签以验证其安全性。
如有任何触电迹象，应立即停止项目，以便在继续工作前由合格电工切断电源。

paragraphs.text: How to manage flexible working with your employees
paragraphs.translation: 如何管理与员工的灵活工作安排

paragraphs.text: A
There is no denying that flexible working has grown enormously in recent years. It does, however, require careful management.
paragraphs.translation:
不可否认，弹性工作在近年来得到了极大的发展。
然而，它确实需要仔细的管理。

paragraphs.text: B

When it comes to implementing flexible working one word is key: trust. All flexible workers should be trusted and given well-defined objectives from the start and their contribution should be assessed according to their output, as opposed to the time they spend on the job. It can be a big step to implement such a change in your business, so if you are slightly cautious then I recommend perhaps setting up an end-of-the-day review to see how much progress has been made. As all parties find their feet with the new set-up, this contact can slowly be reduced.
paragraphs.translation:
在实施弹性工作制时，有一个词至关重要：信任。
所有弹性工作者应受到信任，并从一开始就获得明确的目标，他们的贡献应根据工作成果而非投入的时间来评估。
在您的企业中实施这种改变可能是一个重大步骤，因此如果您有些谨慎，我建议或许可以设立一个每日结束时的复盘，以了解取得了多少进展。
随着各方逐渐适应新的安排，这种沟通可以慢慢减少。

paragraphs.text: C

In my eyes, it is also vital that there is shared calendar access for everyone so that people can see where their colleagues are each day. This way if they need to catch up with someone they can plan when to do so. Technology now exists to enable employees to stay in touch with other members of staff and external partners. iMeet, for example, is a tool which allows all forms of collaboration for remote working, from video conferencing, live chat and file sharing to screen sharing. The new breed of worker is therefore fully equipped to work productively away from the office, and can still feel like they're in the same room as others when necessary.
paragraphs.translation:
在我看来，拥有共享日历的权限对每个人来说也至关重要，这样大家就能了解同事每天的位置。
这样一来，如果需要与某人联系，他们就可以计划何时进行沟通。
现有技术能够使员工与其他同事和外部合作伙伴保持联系。
例如，iMeet 是一个支持远程工作多种协作形式的工具，包括视频会议、实时聊天、文件共享以及屏幕共享。
因此，新一代员工已完全具备在办公室外高效工作的能力，并且在必要时仍能感觉与他人同处一室。

paragraphs.text: D

In my experience, employees are often more productive working at home as they can work the exact hours they want and do not have to cope with distraction caused by other employees. Being outside the confines of the office walls also appears to foster creativity. In addition, we find staff are more motivated as they have a better work-life balance. In terms of the business, we find this helps with top talent recruitment and staff retention, and a happy workforce is a more successful one.
paragraphs.translation:
根据我的经验，员工在家工作时往往效率更高，因为他们可以按照自己确切的时间工作，并且不必应对其他员工造成的干扰。
走出办公室的局限似乎也能激发创造力。
此外，我们发现员工因为拥有更好的工作与生活平衡而更有动力。
从业务角度而言，我们发现这有助于顶尖人才的招聘和员工留存，而一支快乐的员工队伍也更能取得成功。

parts.source_article_title: Workplace health and safety considerations for plumbers

sentence_translations.sentence: Like many trades, plumbing can be a dangerous job.
sentence_translations.translation: 与许多行业一样，水管工可能是一项危险的工作。

sentence_translations.sentence: It is important to take all reasonably practicable measures to keep customers and yourself incident and injury free.
sentence_translations.translation: 采取所有合理可行的措施以确保客户和自身免受事故和伤害至关重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: Biohazard waste
sentence_translations.translation: 生物危害废物

sentence_translations.sentence: Plumbers regularly come into contact with biohazard waste.
sentence_translations.translation: 水管工经常接触生物危害废物。

sentence_translations.sentence: It's the nature of the job, but that doesn't mean you should be complacent about it.
sentence_translations.translation: 这是工作的本质，但这并不意味着你应该对此掉以轻心。

sentence_translations.sentence: According to Safe Work Australia, communicable diseases from work-related exposures to biological hazards such as sewage have been estimated to cause 320,000 deaths across the globe each year.
sentence_translations.translation: 根据澳大利亚安全工作署的数据，工作中接触污水等生物危害导致的传染病估计每年在全球造成32万人死亡。

sentence_translations.sentence: In addition to this, plumbers are regularly exposed to other biohazards such as mould, bacteria and algae.
sentence_translations.translation: 除此之外，水管工还经常接触到其他生物危害，如霉菌、细菌和藻类。

sentence_translations.sentence: Don't risk it - make sure appropriate protective clothing and equipment is used.
sentence_translations.translation: 不要冒险——确保使用适当的防护服和设备。

sentence_translations.sentence: Confined spaces
sentence_translations.translation: 密闭空间

sentence_translations.sentence: Plumbers may spend much of their time working in confined spaces, where they are at risk from contaminants, including airborne gases, vapours and dusts, that may cause injury from fire or explosion.
sentence_translations.translation: 水管工可能花费大量时间在狭小空间工作，在那里他们面临来自污染物的风险，包括空气中的气体、蒸汽和粉尘，这些污染物可能因火灾或爆炸而导致伤害。

sentence_translations.sentence: They may also be exposed to high concentrations of airborne contaminants that may be harmful to health.
sentence_translations.translation: 他们还可能接触到高浓度的空气中的污染物，这些污染物可能对健康有害。

sentence_translations.sentence: For example, one plumber was fined $220,000 after an employee suffered from carbon-monoxide poisoning.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，一名水管工因一名员工遭受一氧化碳中毒而被罚款22万美元。

sentence_translations.sentence: Another potential hazard for plumbers in confined spaces is that of drowning, if water sources are not adequately cut off.
sentence_translations.translation: 水管工在狭小空间中的另一个潜在危险是溺水，如果水源没有被充分切断的话。

sentence_translations.sentence: The Safe Work Australia confined spaces code of practice outlines the necessary steps and precautions for avoiding illness and injury.
sentence_translations.translation: 澳大利亚安全工作局的《密闭空间操作规程》列出了避免疾病和伤害的必要步骤与预防措施。

sentence_translations.sentence: Electricity
sentence_translations.translation: 电力

sentence_translations.sentence: The Master Plumbers' Association calls electricity 'plumbing's hidden killer'.
sentence_translations.translation: 水暖大师协会将电称为‘水暖行业的隐形杀手’。

sentence_translations.sentence: Metal pipes are often conductive and so gloves which provide insulation should form part of a plumber's tool kit, as should a plumbing voltage monitor and a volt tester.
sentence_translations.translation: 金属管道通常具有导电性，因此提供绝缘功能的手套应成为水暖工工具箱的一部分，水暖电压监测器和电压测试仪也应如此。

sentence_translations.sentence: Gloves should be checked prior to every use and replaced every 12 to 14 months.
sentence_translations.translation: 手套应在每次使用前进行检查，并每12至14个月更换一次。

sentence_translations.sentence: Electrical equipment like bridging conductors should be regularly checked, with appropriate tags on the equipment to verify its safety.
sentence_translations.translation: 桥接导线等电气设备应定期检查，并在设备上附有适当的标签以验证其安全性。

sentence_translations.sentence: The project should be stopped immediately if there is any sign of electricity, so that the power can be disconnected by a qualified electrician prior to continuing work.
sentence_translations.translation: 如有任何触电迹象，应立即停止项目，以便在继续工作前由合格电工切断电源。

sentence_translations.sentence: How to manage flexible working with your employees
sentence_translations.translation: 如何管理与员工的灵活工作安排

sentence_translations.sentence: There is no denying that flexible working has grown enormously in recent years.
sentence_translations.translation: 不可否认，弹性工作在近年来得到了极大的发展。

sentence_translations.sentence: It does, however, require careful management.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，它确实需要仔细的管理。

sentence_translations.sentence: When it comes to implementing flexible working one word is key: trust.
sentence_translations.translation: 在实施弹性工作制时，有一个词至关重要：信任。

sentence_translations.sentence: All flexible workers should be trusted and given well-defined objectives from the start and their contribution should be assessed according to their output, as opposed to the time they spend on the job.
sentence_translations.translation: 所有弹性工作者应受到信任，并从一开始就获得明确的目标，他们的贡献应根据工作成果而非投入的时间来评估。

sentence_translations.sentence: It can be a big step to implement such a change in your business, so if you are slightly cautious then I recommend perhaps setting up an end-of-the-day review to see how much progress has been made.
sentence_translations.translation: 在您的企业中实施这种改变可能是一个重大步骤，因此如果您有些谨慎，我建议或许可以设立一个每日结束时的复盘，以了解取得了多少进展。

sentence_translations.sentence: As all parties find their feet with the new set-up, this contact can slowly be reduced.
sentence_translations.translation: 随着各方逐渐适应新的安排，这种沟通可以慢慢减少。

sentence_translations.sentence: In my eyes, it is also vital that there is shared calendar access for everyone so that people can see where their colleagues are each day.
sentence_translations.translation: 在我看来，拥有共享日历的权限对每个人来说也至关重要，这样大家就能了解同事每天的位置。

sentence_translations.sentence: This way if they need to catch up with someone they can plan when to do so.
sentence_translations.translation: 这样一来，如果需要与某人联系，他们就可以计划何时进行沟通。

sentence_translations.sentence: Technology now exists to enable employees to stay in touch with other members of staff and external partners.
sentence_translations.translation: 现有技术能够使员工与其他同事和外部合作伙伴保持联系。

sentence_translations.sentence: iMeet, for example, is a tool which allows all forms of collaboration for remote working, from video conferencing, live chat and file sharing to screen sharing.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，iMeet 是一个支持远程工作多种协作形式的工具，包括视频会议、实时聊天、文件共享以及屏幕共享。

sentence_translations.sentence: The new breed of worker is therefore fully equipped to work productively away from the office, and can still feel like they're in the same room as others when necessary.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，新一代员工已完全具备在办公室外高效工作的能力，并且在必要时仍能感觉与他人同处一室。

sentence_translations.sentence: In my experience, employees are often more productive working at home as they can work the exact hours they want and do not have to cope with distraction caused by other employees.
sentence_translations.translation: 根据我的经验，员工在家工作时往往效率更高，因为他们可以按照自己确切的时间工作，并且不必应对其他员工造成的干扰。

sentence_translations.sentence: Being outside the confines of the office walls also appears to foster creativity.
sentence_translations.translation: 走出办公室的局限似乎也能激发创造力。

sentence_translations.sentence: In addition, we find staff are more motivated as they have a better work-life balance.
sentence_translations.translation: 此外，我们发现员工因为拥有更好的工作与生活平衡而更有动力。

sentence_translations.sentence: In terms of the business, we find this helps with top talent recruitment and staff retention, and a happy workforce is a more successful one.
sentence_translations.translation: 从业务角度而言，我们发现这有助于顶尖人才的招聘和员工留存，而一支快乐的员工队伍也更能取得成功。

parts.article_title: Preventing the theft of turtle eggs

paragraphs.text: Conservationists and law enforcement have struggled to prevent wildlife trafficking. But could some plastic eggs and GPS trackers change the game?
paragraphs.translation:
环境保护主义者和执法部门一直难以阻止野生动物走私。
但一些塑料蛋和GPS追踪器能否改变这一局面呢？

paragraphs.text: A

Humans have been eating sea turtle eggs (and killing adult turtles for meat) for millennia. However, as human populations exploded and as sea turtles began to confront additional threats such as intensive fishing, beach development and climate change, sea turtle populations declined precipitously. Today, all but one of the world's seven species of sea turtles are considered threatened according to the IUCN*Red List. And the one that's not- the flatback turtle - is listed as data deficient, which means scientists simply don't know how it's doing.
paragraphs.translation:
人类食用海龟蛋（并捕杀成年海龟取肉）已有数千年历史。
然而，随着人口激增以及海龟面临集约化捕捞、海滩开发和气候变化等额外威胁，海龟数量急剧下降。
如今，根据世界自然保护联盟濒危物种红色名录，全球七种海龟中除一种外均被视为受威胁物种。
而唯一未被列入的平背海龟则被列为数据缺乏，这意味着科学家根本不清楚其生存状况。
人类食用海龟蛋（以及捕杀成年海龟获取肉食）已有数千年之久。
然而，随着人口激增以及海龟开始面临集约化捕捞、海滩开发和气候变化等额外威胁，海龟数量急剧下降。
如今，根据世界自然保护联盟（IUCN）红色名录，全球七种海龟中除一种外均被视为受威胁物种。
而未受威胁的那一种——平背海龟——被列为数据缺乏，这意味着科学家根本不清楚其生存状况。
人类食用海龟蛋（并捕杀成年海龟获取肉食）已持续数千年之久。
然而，随着人口激增，海龟开始面临密集捕捞、海滩开发和气候变化等额外威胁，其数量急剧下降。
而唯一未被列入受威胁物种的平背龟则被列为数据缺乏，这意味着科学家们尚不清楚其生存状况。

paragraphs.text: B

One major problem is that every year millions of sea turtle eggs are illegally taken by poachers for sale on the black market. The situation is particularly serious in Nicaragua, in Central America, which is home to four sea turtle species.
paragraphs.translation:
一个主要问题是，每年有数百万枚海龟蛋被偷猎者非法获取，并在黑市上出售。
这种情况在中美洲的尼加拉瓜尤为严峻，该地是四种海龟的栖息地。
一个主要问题是，每年都有数百万枚海龟蛋被偷猎者非法获取，并在黑市上出售。
中美洲的尼加拉瓜情况尤为严峻，该国是四种海龟的栖息地。

paragraphs.text: Kim Williams-Guillen, who works for conservation body Paso Pacifico, described the poaching of sea turtle nests on the beaches of Nicaragua as 'uncontrolled, unregulated, extensive and contested'. Even the best-protected beaches are plundered to some extent and it's not uncommon to see poachers digging up nests just meters from tourists watching sea turtles laying their clutch at night, she said. This poaching becomes particularly frenzied during the arribadas - mass laying events where thousands of turtles nest on the same beach for a single night in a biological strategy to overwhelm natural predators.
paragraphs.translation:
在保护组织Paso Pacifico工作的Kim Williams-Guillen将尼加拉瓜海滩上海龟巢穴被偷猎的行为描述为‘不受控制、不受监管、广泛且存在争议’。
她说，即便是保护最严密的海滩也在一定程度上遭到掠夺，并且经常看到偷猎者在距离夜间观看海龟产卵的游客仅几米远的地方挖掘巢穴。
在‘arribadas’（大量产卵事件）期间，这种偷猎行为变得尤为疯狂——成千上万只海龟在同一海滩上筑巢一夜，这是一种通过数量压倒天敌的生物策略。

paragraphs.text: C

'Even with armed guards, the numbers of poachers overwhelm military personnel by ten or twenty to one,' Williams-Guillen said. 'Although many poachers are locals with limited resources, during these arribadas there are influxes of gangs of poachers from larger cities outside local communities. These are not just local poor people without other options.’
paragraphs.translation:
“即使有武装警卫，偷猎者的数量也以十比一或二十比一的比例压倒军事人员，”威廉姆斯-吉伦说道。
“尽管许多偷猎者是资源有限的当地人，但在这些大规模产卵期间，会涌入来自当地社区以外大城市的偷猎团伙。
这些不仅仅是别无选择的当地穷人。”

paragraphs.text: But to protect the country's sea turtles, Williams-Guillen said conservationists shouldn't just depend on catching low-level operators. 'If one poacher decides to stop, another one will just step into his place... we need to know more about the middlemen and people higher up in the distribution chain,' she said.
paragraphs.translation:
但为了保护该国的海龟，威廉姆斯-吉伦表示，保护主义者不应仅仅依赖抓捕底层操作者。
她说：“如果一个偷猎者决定停止，另一个人就会接替他的位置……我们需要更多地了解中间商和分销链中更高层级的人。”

paragraphs.text: D

Paso Pacifico's solution is the creation of high-tech sea turtle eggs: fake eggs convincingly crafted to look like the real thing, but which contain GPS tracking devices. These have the potential to reveal the destination markets for trafficked sea turtle eggs.
paragraphs.translation:
帕索帕西菲科的解决方案是制造高科技海龟蛋：这些假蛋被精心制作得看起来跟真蛋一模一样，但内部装有GPS追踪装置。
这些假蛋有可能揭示被贩运海龟蛋的最终市场。
Paso Pacifico的解决方案是制作高科技海龟蛋：这些假蛋被精心制作，看起来与真蛋无异，但其中包含GPS追踪装置。
这些假蛋有望揭示被走私海龟蛋的目的地市场。

paragraphs.text: Making convincing sea turtle eggs is not easy, and Paso Pacifico is still working on perfecting a prototype. In particular, it's proving quite problematic to create the right texture, since sea turtle eggs are not covered in a hard shell like those of birds, but are quite flexible.
paragraphs.translation:
制作逼真的海龟蛋并不容易，Paso Pacifico仍在努力完善原型。
特别是，要创造出合适的质地相当困难，因为海龟蛋不像鸟蛋那样有坚硬的壳，而是相当有弹性。

paragraphs.text: So Paso Pacifico brought in Lauren Wilde, a special effects artist in the US, to create a convincing outer shell. First, Wilde had to get her hands on the real thing. Since it's illegal to send sea turtle eggs over the border, Wilde is using land turtle eggs from California. 'It was really eye opening and important for me to feel these eggs and how the shell bends a little,' she said.
paragraphs.translation:
因此，帕索帕西菲科组织请来了美国的特效艺术家劳伦·怀尔德，来制作一个逼真的外层蛋壳。
首先，怀尔德必须获得真品。
由于跨边境邮寄海龟蛋属于非法行为，怀尔德使用的是来自加州陆龟的蛋。
“触摸这些蛋并感受蛋壳能轻微弯曲，这真的让我大开眼界，也至关重要，”她说道。

paragraphs.text: To get the GPS device inside the shell, Paso Pacifico is using 3D printers to make a plastic ball which will then have a GPS transmitter fitted inside. This will take the place of the embryo inside the shell. Lastly the fake shells will be sealed with silicone, waterproofing them.
paragraphs.translation:
为了将GPS设备放入蛋壳内，帕索太平洋组织正在使用3D打印机制作一个塑料球，随后将在其内部安装GPS发射器。
这将替代蛋壳内的胚胎。
最后，假的蛋壳将用硅胶密封，使其防水。

paragraphs.text: E

Sea turtles on average lay around 100 eggs in a nest, and once the fake eggs are finished they will be slipped in with the real ones. Williams-Guillen said it might even be possible to deliver fake eggs into nests while poachers are at work. Wary of tourists, poachers will often back off if strangers come near and then return when they have gone. 'It would be pretty easy to drop an egg in the dark into a nest they have been digging up,' she said.
paragraphs.translation:
海龟平均每个巢穴产约100枚蛋，一旦假蛋制作完成，它们将被混入真蛋中。
威廉姆斯-吉伦表示，甚至有可能在偷猎者作案时将假蛋放入巢穴中。
由于对游客保持警惕，偷猎者常常会在陌生人靠近时后退，待其离开后再返回。
“在黑暗中把一枚蛋丢进他们正在挖掘的巢穴里是相当容易的，”她说。
海龟平均在每个巢穴中产下约100枚卵，一旦这些假卵制作完成，它们将被混入真卵中。

parts.source_article_title: Preventing the theft of turtle eggs

sentence_translations.sentence: Conservationists and law enforcement have struggled to prevent wildlife trafficking.
sentence_translations.translation: 环境保护主义者和执法部门一直难以阻止野生动物走私。

sentence_translations.sentence: But could some plastic eggs and GPS trackers change the game?
sentence_translations.translation: 但一些塑料蛋和GPS追踪器能否改变这一局面呢？

sentence_translations.sentence: Humans have been eating sea turtle eggs (and killing adult turtles for meat) for millennia.
sentence_translations.translation: 人类食用海龟蛋（并捕杀成年海龟取肉）已有数千年历史。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, as human populations exploded and as sea turtles began to confront additional threats such as intensive fishing, beach development and climate change, sea turtle populations declined precipitously.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，随着人口激增以及海龟面临集约化捕捞、海滩开发和气候变化等额外威胁，海龟数量急剧下降。

sentence_translations.sentence: Today, all but one of the world's seven species of sea turtles are considered threatened according to the IUCN*Red List.
sentence_translations.translation: 如今，根据世界自然保护联盟濒危物种红色名录，全球七种海龟中除一种外均被视为受威胁物种。

sentence_translations.sentence: And the one that's not- the flatback turtle - is listed as data deficient, which means scientists simply don't know how it's doing.
sentence_translations.translation: 而唯一未被列入的平背海龟则被列为数据缺乏，这意味着科学家根本不清楚其生存状况。

sentence_translations.sentence: To date, Paso Pacifico has yet to put a single fake egg in a nest.
sentence_translations.translation: 迄今为止，帕索太平洋组织尚未将任何一颗假蛋放入巢穴中。

sentence_translations.sentence: But Williams-Guillen said she isn't too concerned that publicity for their scheme will result in poachers looking for the eggs.
sentence_translations.translation: 但威廉姆斯-吉伦表示，她并不太担心他们计划的宣传会导致偷猎者寻找这些假蛋。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'The vast majority of the poaching is happening at night, so already it is hard to tell [the eggs] apart, and at this point, poachers and middlemen are not closely inspecting eggs, but rather shoving them into a sack as quickly as possible.'
sentence_translations.translation: '绝大多数偷猎行为发生在夜间，因此已经很难区分真假蛋，而且目前偷猎者和中间商并不会仔细检查蛋，而是尽快将它们塞进麻袋。'

sentence_translations.sentence: One major problem is that every year millions of sea turtle eggs are illegally taken by poachers for sale on the black market.
sentence_translations.translation: 一个主要问题是，每年有数百万枚海龟蛋被偷猎者非法获取，并在黑市上出售。

sentence_translations.sentence: One major problem is that every year millions of sea turtle eggs are illegally taken by poachers for sale on the black market.
sentence_translations.translation: 一个主要问题是，每年有数百万枚海龟蛋被偷猎者非法获取，并在黑市上出售。

sentence_translations.sentence: The situation is particularly serious in Nicaragua, in Central America, which is home to four sea turtle species.
sentence_translations.translation: 这种情况在中美洲的尼加拉瓜尤为严峻，该地是四种海龟的栖息地。

sentence_translations.translation: 一个主要问题是，每年都有数百万枚海龟蛋被偷猎者非法获取，并在黑市上出售。

sentence_translations.sentence: The situation is particularly serious in Nicaragua, in Central America, which is home to four sea turtle species.
sentence_translations.translation: 中美洲的尼加拉瓜情况尤为严峻，该国是四种海龟的栖息地。

sentence_translations.sentence: Kim Williams-Guillen, who works for conservation body Paso Pacifico, described the poaching of sea turtle nests on the beaches of Nicaragua as 'uncontrolled, unregulated, extensive and contested'.
sentence_translations.translation: 在保护组织Paso Pacifico工作的Kim Williams-Guillen将尼加拉瓜海滩上海龟巢穴被偷猎的行为描述为‘不受控制、不受监管、广泛且存在争议’。

sentence_translations.sentence: Even the best-protected beaches are plundered to some extent and it's not uncommon to see poachers digging up nests just meters from tourists watching sea turtles laying their clutch at night, she said.
sentence_translations.translation: 她说，即便是保护最严密的海滩也在一定程度上遭到掠夺，并且经常看到偷猎者在距离夜间观看海龟产卵的游客仅几米远的地方挖掘巢穴。

sentence_translations.sentence: This poaching becomes particularly frenzied during the arribadas - mass laying events where thousands of turtles nest on the same beach for a single night in a biological strategy to overwhelm natural predators.
sentence_translations.translation: 在‘arribadas’（大量产卵事件）期间，这种偷猎行为变得尤为疯狂——成千上万只海龟在同一海滩上筑巢一夜，这是一种通过数量压倒天敌的生物策略。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'Even with armed guards, the numbers of poachers overwhelm military personnel by ten or twenty to one,' Williams-Guillen said.
sentence_translations.translation: “即使有武装警卫，偷猎者的数量也以十比一或二十比一的比例压倒军事人员，”威廉姆斯-吉伦说道。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'Although many poachers are locals with limited resources, during these arribadas there are influxes of gangs of poachers from larger cities outside local communities.
sentence_translations.translation: “尽管许多偷猎者是资源有限的当地人，但在这些大规模产卵期间，会涌入来自当地社区以外大城市的偷猎团伙。

sentence_translations.sentence: These are not just local poor people without other options.’
sentence_translations.translation: 这些不仅仅是别无选择的当地穷人。”

sentence_translations.sentence: But to protect the country's sea turtles, Williams-Guillen said conservationists shouldn't just depend on catching low-level operators.
sentence_translations.translation: 但为了保护该国的海龟，威廉姆斯-吉伦表示，保护主义者不应仅仅依赖抓捕底层操作者。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'If one poacher decides to stop, another one will just step into his place... we need to know more about the middlemen and people higher up in the distribution chain,' she said.
sentence_translations.translation: 她说：“如果一个偷猎者决定停止，另一个人就会接替他的位置……我们需要更多地了解中间商和分销链中更高层级的人。”

sentence_translations.sentence: Paso Pacifico's solution is the creation of high-tech sea turtle eggs: fake eggs convincingly crafted to look like the real thing, but which contain GPS tracking devices.
sentence_translations.translation: 帕索帕西菲科的解决方案是制造高科技海龟蛋：这些假蛋被精心制作得看起来跟真蛋一模一样，但内部装有GPS追踪装置。

sentence_translations.sentence: These have the potential to reveal the destination markets for trafficked sea turtle eggs.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些假蛋有可能揭示被贩运海龟蛋的最终市场。

sentence_translations.sentence: Paso Pacifico's solution is the creation of high-tech sea turtle eggs: fake eggs convincingly crafted to look like the real thing, but which contain GPS tracking devices.
sentence_translations.translation: Paso Pacifico的解决方案是制作高科技海龟蛋：这些假蛋被精心制作，看起来与真蛋无异，但其中包含GPS追踪装置。

sentence_translations.sentence: These have the potential to reveal the destination markets for trafficked sea turtle eggs.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些假蛋有望揭示被走私海龟蛋的目的地市场。

sentence_translations.sentence: Making convincing sea turtle eggs is not easy, and Paso Pacifico is still working on perfecting a prototype.
sentence_translations.translation: 制作逼真的海龟蛋并不容易，Paso Pacifico仍在努力完善原型。

sentence_translations.sentence: In particular, it's proving quite problematic to create the right texture, since sea turtle eggs are not covered in a hard shell like those of birds, but are quite flexible.
sentence_translations.translation: 特别是，要创造出合适的质地相当困难，因为海龟蛋不像鸟蛋那样有坚硬的壳，而是相当有弹性。

sentence_translations.sentence: So Paso Pacifico brought in Lauren Wilde, a special effects artist in the US, to create a convincing outer shell.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，帕索帕西菲科组织请来了美国的特效艺术家劳伦·怀尔德，来制作一个逼真的外层蛋壳。

sentence_translations.sentence: First, Wilde had to get her hands on the real thing.
sentence_translations.translation: 首先，怀尔德必须获得真品。

sentence_translations.sentence: Since it's illegal to send sea turtle eggs over the border, Wilde is using land turtle eggs from California.
sentence_translations.translation: 由于跨边境邮寄海龟蛋属于非法行为，怀尔德使用的是来自加州陆龟的蛋。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'It was really eye opening and important for me to feel these eggs and how the shell bends a little,' she said.
sentence_translations.translation: “触摸这些蛋并感受蛋壳能轻微弯曲，这真的让我大开眼界，也至关重要，”她说道。

sentence_translations.sentence: To get the GPS device inside the shell, Paso Pacifico is using 3D printers to make a plastic ball which will then have a GPS transmitter fitted inside.
sentence_translations.translation: 为了将GPS设备放入蛋壳内，帕索太平洋组织正在使用3D打印机制作一个塑料球，随后将在其内部安装GPS发射器。

sentence_translations.sentence: This will take the place of the embryo inside the shell.
sentence_translations.translation: 这将替代蛋壳内的胚胎。

sentence_translations.sentence: Lastly the fake shells will be sealed with silicone, waterproofing them.
sentence_translations.translation: 最后，假的蛋壳将用硅胶密封，使其防水。

sentence_translations.sentence: Sea turtles on average lay around 100 eggs in a nest, and once the fake eggs are finished they will be slipped in with the real ones.
sentence_translations.translation: 海龟平均每个巢穴产约100枚蛋，一旦假蛋制作完成，它们将被混入真蛋中。

sentence_translations.sentence: Williams-Guillen said it might even be possible to deliver fake eggs into nests while poachers are at work.
sentence_translations.translation: 威廉姆斯-吉伦表示，甚至有可能在偷猎者作案时将假蛋放入巢穴中。

sentence_translations.sentence: Wary of tourists, poachers will often back off if strangers come near and then return when they have gone.
sentence_translations.translation: 由于对游客保持警惕，偷猎者常常会在陌生人靠近时后退，待其离开后再返回。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'It would be pretty easy to drop an egg in the dark into a nest they have been digging up,' she said.
sentence_translations.translation: “在黑暗中把一枚蛋丢进他们正在挖掘的巢穴里是相当容易的，”她说。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'It would be pretty easy to drop an egg in the dark into a nest they have been digging up,' she said.
sentence_translations.translation: 她说：“在黑暗中把一枚蛋扔进他们正在挖掘的巢穴里，是相当容易的。”

sentence_translations.sentence: Once the poacher picks up the fake egg along with the real ones, conservationists and law enforcement agents will be able to track them.
sentence_translations.translation: 一旦偷猎者将假蛋与真蛋一同捡起，环保人士和执法人员就能追踪它们。

sentence_translations.sentence: Experts believe most of the stolen eggs eventually make their way out of Nicaragua, possibly to El Salvador or Guatemala.
sentence_translations.translation: 专家认为，大多数被盗的蛋最终被运出尼加拉瓜，可能流向萨尔瓦多或危地马拉。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, there is also growing concern that sea turtle eggs from Central America are actually heading to the USA, from where they are sold on to other countries around the world.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，人们也越来越担忧，来自中美洲的海龟蛋实际上正被运往美国，并从那里转售到全球其他国家。

sentence_translations.sentence: To date, Paso Pacifico has yet to put a single fake egg in a nest.
sentence_translations.translation: 迄今为止，帕索帕西菲科尚未将一枚假蛋放入任何一个巢穴中。

sentence_translations.sentence: But Williams-Guillen said she isn't too concerned that publicity for their scheme will result in poachers looking for the eggs.
sentence_translations.translation: 但威廉姆斯-吉伦表示，她并不太担心其计划的公开会导致偷猎者搜寻这些蛋。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'The vast majority of the poaching is happening at night, so already it is hard to tell [the eggs] apart, and at this point, poachers and middlemen are not closely inspecting eggs, but rather shoving them into a sack as quickly as possible.'
sentence_translations.translation: “绝大多数偷猎活动发生在夜间，因此已经很难分辨[这些蛋]，而目前，偷猎者和中间商并不会仔细检查蛋，而是尽快把它们塞进袋子里。”

sentence_translations.sentence: Of course, poachers will eventually become aware of the prospect of fake eggs among the real ones - especially when customers try to bite into an egg and break their teeth on the GPS transmitter instead.
sentence_translations.translation: 当然，偷猎者最终会意识到真蛋中可能有假蛋的存在——尤其是当顾客试图咬开蛋，却反而在GPS发射器上崩坏牙齿时。

sentence_translations.sentence: So, Paso Pacifico plans to do a massive deployment of as many fakes as possible to gather a lot of data before poachers get wise.
sentence_translations.translation: 因此，帕索帕西菲科计划在偷猎者警觉之前，大规模部署尽可能多的假蛋，以收集大量数据。

sentence_translations.sentence: Knowing where the eggs go will allow conservationists and law enforcement agents to focus their resources on the right places - whether it be through awareness-building campaigns or crackdowns on illegal sellers.
sentence_translations.translation: 了解这些蛋的去向将使保护主义者和执法人员能够将资源集中在正确的地方——无论是通过提高意识的活动还是打击非法卖家。

sentence_translations.sentence: And eventually Paso Pacifico hopes to share the technology with interested parties around the world.
sentence_translations.translation: 最终，帕索帕西菲科希望与世界各地感兴趣的团体共享这项技术。
